verdict.rationale: Bolt ships a native 'Bolt Database' that can be added during project creation without extra infrastructure, plus an alternative Supabase integration offering hosted SQL, auth, and edge functions selectable at setup — both wired in without leaving the builder per docs [bolt-docs-33][bolt-docs-27][bolt-docs-22][bolt-docs-36][bolt-docs-34]. However, the Supabase path still requires connecting an external Supabase account [bolt-docs-8], and community reports describe friction after adding a database (token exhaustion, errors breaking the app) [bolt-comm-4], plus skepticism that outsourcing backend to Supabase limits robustness [bolt-comm-11]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth, error-free end-to-end database provisioning flow, and clarity on whether Supabase setup ever requires leaving Bolt's UI.
